changes.summary: Read-only project/snapshot/counts/languages/freshness projection shared with the CLI status command.

query.project_id: optional; when absent every registered project is listed
query.workspace_handle: optional authorized workspace handle; adds a read-only drift comparison

response.projects: project record, latest_snapshot_id, snapshot summary, counts, languages, freshness

changes.behavior: creates no snapshot, writes no drift report and executes no repository command

changes.summary: Static task-level review of the current workspace against a frozen snapshot.

request.workspace_handle: required authorized handle; arbitrary paths are refused
request.base_snapshot_id: optional; defaults to the latest snapshot

response.files[]: path, state, base/current digest, line_changes, base-anchor entities, trigger, confidence, impact
response.claims_at_risk: claims whose scope overlaps changed paths
response.verification: always not_run for this static review

changes.behavior: no build, test, scenario or runtime command is executed; binary/oversized/unmapped files make coverage partial
refresh captures/indexes a new snapshot and reports the exact snapshot-to-snapshot delta; the old snapshot is retained

commands: ARCHMELD: Filter Graph by Runtime Run
changes.behavior: dragged positions persist per project/snapshot/view; module and architecture-component projections retain underlying relation/evidence ids; runtime filtering labels edges as static adjacency
